name: Jeriel
title: Son of Tola from the tribe of Issachar
summary: Jeriel was one of the sons of Tola, son of Issachar, and is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as one of the heads of his families. He belonged to the tribe of Issachar and was among the brave warriors recorded in the genealogies. His significance lies in his role as a patriarch and leader within his clan in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the genealogy of Issachar
keyEvents.description: Jeriel is mentioned as one of the sons of Tola, son of Issachar, in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles. He was among the heads of their fathers' houses.

keyEvents.title: Tent as a valiant warrior
keyEvents.description: Jeriel was among the brave men of the tribe of Issachar who were recorded in the genealogies and formed a significant military force in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Part of the census of the tribe of Issachar
keyEvents.description: In connection with the registration of the tribes of Israel, Jeriel's clan was counted among the 22,600 valiant warriors under Tola's lineage.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Issachar in Israel's history
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Issachar, to which Jeriel belonged, played an important role in early Israelite history. The tribe's blessing was pronounced by Jacob before his death.
